# `trigger-bump-dispatch.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| bump_source | Identifier for this producer. The downstream receiver maps it to the image name and the files pinning it, so this string is a contract with docker-apps' bump-image-pin.yml -- not a free-form label. | `string` | n/a | yes |
| fail_on_error | Whether a failed dispatch fails this workflow. Defaults false, matching the GitLab job's allow_failure: true -- the image is already pushed, so a downstream automation hiccup should not retroactively fail the producer. | `boolean` | `false` | no |
| image | Full image reference without a tag. Recorded in the dispatch payload and the log line; NOT used to decide what gets rewritten. | `string` | n/a | yes |
| image_tag | Tag to pin to, normally the short commit SHA | `string` | n/a | yes |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |
| target_repo | owner/repo of the GitOps repository to dispatch to | `string` | `tnoff/docker-apps` | no |

## Secrets

| Name | Description | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :------: |
| app_client_id | Client ID of the tnoff-ci App. The Iv23li... form, NOT the numeric App ID -- create-github-app-token deprecated its `app-id` input in favour of `client-id`. | yes |
| app_private_key | Private key PEM of the tnoff-ci App. Needs Contents: write on the TARGET repo, which is what the repository_dispatch API requires. The App must be installed on the target as well as on this producer. | yes |
